title: Helwit Banana Nicotine Pouches 7mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Banana Nicotine Pouches offer a soft and subtly sweet take on Banana flavour, pairing creamy notes with a gentle smoothness that makes this a comfortable all-day pouch. Inspired by mellow confectionery-style banana, the taste is light and inviting without being overly sweet. Each pouch is crafted from plant-based materials and designed to sit neatly under the lip for discreet use anywhere. The 7mg nicotine strength is ideal for users seeking a moderate, steady release without smoke, vapour or odour. A pleasant and easy-going pouch for fans of fruit-inspired flavours. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
